description: Points a subdomain (normally www) of the customer's domain at their Maleem store. Maleem serves it through Cloudflare for SaaS; the certificate is issued over HTTP once the CNAME resolves.
variableDescription: mlstore: the store's own label at Maleem (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens), e.g. nour-x7k2m9. The CNAME target is <mlstore>.stores.maleem.store.
